blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) has disqualified five money service businesses operating without prior registration, barring their owners from running other sole proprietorships as well. The Monetary Board, the BSP’s policy-making body, named Shara-P Money Changing Services and Downtown Money Changer among the five entities disqualified for operating without the central bank’s registration. The other entities are Ponio Money Changing Services, Jamelah-Arham Gift Shop, also known as Jamelah-Arham Money Changer, and JNJ Money Changing Services. The BSP said the disqualifications form part of its efforts to protect financial consumers and safeguard the stability of the Philippine financial system. /pai...
